realYields.source: U.S. Department of the Treasury — Daily Treasury Par Real Yield Curve Rates

dollar.source: Federal Reserve H.10 — Nominal Broad U.S. Dollar Index

inflation.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics — CPI-U

centralBankDemand.source: World Gold Council — Gold Demand Trends / central banks
centralBankDemand.classificationNote: V1 uses a disclosed reviewed threshold table rather than republishing a long specialist-source history.

fiscalStress.sourceBaseline: CBO Budget and Economic Outlook: 2026 to 2036
fiscalStress.rationale: The reviewed CBO baseline shows debt held by the public and net interest at historically elevated levels with a rising longer-run path; this is classified as very elevated fiscal stress, not as a default prediction.

stress.gprSource: Caldara-Iacoviello Geopolitical Risk Index — Recent Daily GPR
stress.ofrSource: Office of Financial Research — Financial Stress Index

notes.browserDataPolicy: The production browser reads this bundled file only and does not call external macro-data providers.
notes.maintenancePolicy: Automated weekly fields update only through a validated protected PR. Central-bank demand and fiscal stress remain reviewed fields.
notes.educationalUse: Reference classifications describe macro conditions in this framework and do not predict gold prices or investment returns.
